findings.statement: The admitted baseline inventory has 771 members; 766 current source bytes are present in Craft and 5 development paths are absent.
The admitted baseline is also semantically stale against 24 current source members. Those same current bytes were copied exactly into Craft, so this is source-baseline drift, not Craft-only drift.

The baseline manifest, owner decision, validator, ontology current-state views, and materializer remain outside Craft, so the copied current-definition projections do not have local validation closure.
The copied Craft ledger still addresses 126 development artifacts that were excluded from the transplant.
Active writer-owned work exists in evf-reference-consumer, evolvable-validation-framework and must not be silently frozen by this inventory.
Ignored and generated build residue is evidence of local execution state, not a migration candidate.

recommended_sequence.name: Resolve the baseline epoch
recommended_sequence.action: Review the 24 current-source changes against baseline v2 and choose a successor current-baseline candidate or an explicit restoration. Do not label baseline v2 current while this drift remains.

recommended_sequence.name: Preserve the baseline bridge
recommended_sequence.action: Author one exact historical bridge candidate for the six control-plane records plus the five missing frozen members, retaining their old identity and claim ceiling.

recommended_sequence.name: Reconcile copied ledger references
recommended_sequence.action: For every development artifact reference, choose local migration, explicit external source binding, or deliberate retirement; never leave an accidental broken local path.

recommended_sequence.name: Freeze active writer-owned work
recommended_sequence.action: Create a new immutable source epoch for EVF and the EVF reference consumer only after their current owner declares the selected bytes stable.

recommended_sequence.name: Migrate bounded product and evidence bundles
recommended_sequence.action: Move T1 bundles by dependency closure and lane, keeping product-construction evidence separate from operational-support residue.

recommended_sequence.name: Retain history without bulk copying
recommended_sequence.action: Keep T2 and T3 development history at an explicit source locator unless a live consumer proves it is needed.

claim_ceiling: This inventory proves only the observed source population, exact current baseline gap, ledger-addressed surfaces, and migration classifications at this source epoch. It does not accept, admit, copy, rebind, activate, publish, release, deploy, or retire any artifact.
